notes.subject: גשם נדבות
notes.rationale: 'shower of freewill-offerings' — literal rain, or metaphor for bounty; some repoint to 'plentiful rain' (KJV).

notes.subject: נחלתך
notes.rationale: 'your inheritance/portion' rendered as 'ol manmeri bilong yu' — the people as YHWH's inheritance.

notes.subject: ⟨ol⟩
notes.rationale: Object pronoun added: Hebrew כוננתה carries the object suffix within the verb.

translation: Ran bilong ol ofa ol i givim long laik bilong ol yet, Elohim yu ritim i kamap; ol manmeri bilong yu i bin pen sindaun, na yu kirapim ⟨ol⟩ gut.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol ofa ol i givim long laik bilong ol yet
